# 過去莊嚴劫千佛名經

**ID:** T0446b
**Volume:** T14
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 502–557
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0446b

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Guòqù zhuāngyán jié qiān fómíng jīng* (T446b) is the second recension of the Past Ornate Aeon thousand-Buddha-names text. It differs from recension a ([KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022), T446a) in textual organization and may represent a different manuscript tradition or a supplementary list. The source text (T446b) carries a variant title: 過去莊嚴劫千佛名經(一名「集諸佛大功德山」), giving the alternative title "Collection of the Great Merit-Mountain of All Buddhas" (集諸佛大功德山). The "orig" edition note (in place of a named printed edition) suggests this recension was preserved in an earlier manuscript tradition not fully represented in the major printed canons. As with recension a, no translator is identified.

**Abstract**

T446b represents a parallel textual transmission of the thousand-Buddha-names for the past aeon, distinguished from T446a ([KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022)) by its alternative title (集諸佛大功德山) and differing textual arrangement. The "a" and "b" recensions together constitute the full Taishō witness to this particular thousand-Buddha-names list. Both are anonymous, undatable with precision, and are best understood as products of the Chinese liturgical elaboration of the "three aeons, three thousand Buddhas" (*sān jié sānqiān fó* 三劫三千佛) devotional system. See also [KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022), [KR6i0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0024)–[KR6i0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0027).
